flyer.justification: The draft conflates the 27km LHC circumference with the ATLAS detector and exceeds the maximum 6-word title constraint.

linkedin.justification: Follows all LinkedIn format instructions smoothly without forbidden clichés and accurately summarizes the talk's main themes.

summary.justification: Well-structured briefing that clearly outlines evidence, discussion points, and action items within word limits.

instagram.justification: Captures the story effectively with excellent carousel visual cues, emojis, call to action, and exactly 10 relevant hashtags.

newsletter.justification: Meets all requirements including a subject line under 50 characters, three distinct bold subheadings, and a conversational tone.

blog.justification: Well written and covers all key points, but fails to include the required comparison/takeaway table.
